data.description:
## Description
**What**: Ship plugins/dso/scripts/intent-allocation-validate.sh <epic-id> that consumes the merged manifest from read.sh and emits the six finding types: orphan_intent, unresolved_ambiguity, stale_entry, pending_intent, lightweight_pending, cross_epic_reference. Supports --summary-mode (group by type, count-only) for high-volume epics. Exits 0 when no actionable findings, non-zero with a count when issues are present.
**Why**: Completes the validate half of the walking skeleton and supplies the finding vocabulary the a03c hook (sc-7) and the e2e test (sc-10) consume.
**Scope**:
- IN: the six finding-type classifiers; --summary-mode; exit-code semantics (pending_intent/lightweight_pending classification per spec — pending_intent informational, lightweight_pending actionable).
- OUT: read/merge logic (sc-5, consumed here); a03c hook wiring (sc-7).

## Done Definitions

- intent-allocation-validate.sh <epic-id> classifies merged-manifest findings into the six types orphan_intent, unresolved_ambiguity, stale_entry, pending_intent, lightweight_pending, and cross_epic_reference ← Satisfies: sc-6
- An intent_id seeded in a comment but with no resolved entry after merge is reported as orphan_intent, and a lightweight=true item is reported as lightweight_pending distinct from orphan_intent ← Satisfies: sc-6
- --summary-mode groups findings by type with count-only output ← Satisfies: sc-6
- The script exits 0 when only informational pending_intent findings exist and exits non-zero with the finding count when actionable findings are present ← Satisfies: sc-6
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic, covering each of the six finding types and both exit-code paths ← Satisfies: sc-6

## Considerations

- [Classification] pending_intent (deferred=true) is informational and non-blocking; lightweight_pending (lightweight=true) is actionable. Conflating them re-creates the orphan-vs-placeholder ambiguity this finding type exists to remove.
- [Cross-epic] cross_epic_reference fires only when owner_ticket resolves outside the subtree AND shared_infra is unset.
- [Shell hygiene] intent-allocation-validate.sh is a new .sh file; set the executable bit on creation.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a sprint orchestrator, I want intent-allocation-validate.sh to classify the merged manifest into the six finding types with a summary mode, so that orphan and conflict hygiene is checkable.
